Charts: the native @/components/charts recharts barrel only renders 'unavailable' placeholders, so a real native NativeSeriesChart (proportional View bars in a horizontal ScrollView with a legend + x labels, per-series auto-scale for the dual-axis speed chart and a fixed [0,1] domain + Yes/No y ticks for the presence chart) is built instead, following the DriveScorePage precedent; the Recharts hover tooltip/gradients/ResponsiveContainer are SVG-only and unavailable on native. The DataTable degrades to a header-row + rows in a horizontal ScrollView keeping the controlled sortKey/sortDir/onSort and internal pagination at the web default page size 25.
